scripts.install-all: npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --workspace=client --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --workspace=server --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=client & npm run dev --workspace=server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --workspace=client && npm run type-check --workspace=server
